mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, notification_source, type, message, related_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notificationSource}, #{type}, #{message}, #{relatedId})
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, user_id, notification_source, type, message, related_id, is_read, created_at, updated_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = false
